messages:
dana: quick check: we're ready to try rwd-v4p0-int4 behind canary-gate. onboarding notes: pinned model tag v4p0-2026-03-20, quant map applied. main concern = subtle regressions on long-context summarization slices.
omar: what metrics do we want enforced automatically? my vote: composite gate of (1) quality: rougeL delta >= -1.5% (paired), (2) latency: p95 <= +60ms, (3) perplexity shift <= +0.8 relative, and (4) no error-rate spike > 0.2%.
dana: add a warmup requirement: KV warmup success (kv_hit_rate >= 65% on long-doc slice) after N warmup requests (default 1500). if warmup fails, keep in shadow.
lee: for A/B and canary math: require paired quiet-shadow at 10% for 2h. if paired sample size for high-importance slices < 5k, block auto-promote and require manual review.
anita: important: for calibration-sensitive slices we should compute token-gap distribution and require the median gap delta >= -0.3 not to fail. also prefer paired tests (same requests) to reduce variance.
omar: rollback rules: auto-fallback if any of the following hold for 3 consecutive 10m windows: paired p-value < 0.05 AND effect size beyond threshold for that metric. also immediate abort if systemic errors > 0.5% in a single window.
dana: versioning note: promote should create immutable release tag in the model registry and an audit entry with rollout policy. we need an API to fetch the gate config for any tag.
lee: telemetry: collect raw logits for at least 1k paired requests for debugging; retention 7d. annotate dashboard with quiet-shadow pairing events.
rollout-bot: gate config saved: {"model_tag":"v4p0-2026-03-20","warmup_requests":"1500","quiet_shadow_pct":"10","quiet_shadow_window":"2h","canary_steps":"1%->5%->20%","quality_gate":"rougeL_delta>=-1.5%","latency_gate":"p95<=+60ms","perplexity_gate":"<=+0.8","kv_hit_rate":">=65%","paired_p_threshold":"0.05","stability_windows":"3x10m","auto_fallback":"true"} (use /rollout show to modify)
anita: i'll draft a short runbook for ops covering manual override, paired-test extraction, and how to abort safe-promote.
omar: one more: add a soft-flag to limit global promote if any high-importance slice has low sample; allow progressive rollout but require manual signoff at 20%.
dana: agreed. i'll schedule a smoke run tomorrow 09:00 UTC and post results here. thanks! :rocket:
